threads.body: `httpserver.Host` is only the bind address, not the primary virtual server name these APIs expect. The v0.70.0 helper explicitly documents `""` for an unknown server name and falls back to `req.Host` ([source](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go-contrib/blob/c8a87a60ba1b3374fd16df11fc3eeae6c41abbc9/instrumentation/github.com/gin-gonic/gin/otelgin/internal/semconv/server.go#L83-L102)). Passing the bind address makes the scenario supply `server.address` instead of measuring what the instrumentation derives. Pass `""` in all four scenarios, matching net/http.
